plainText:
Lisa (Japanese: リン Rin) is a supporting character who appeared in Spell of the Unown: Entei. She is a Pokémon Trainer who challenged to a Full Battle.

==History==
While and were traveling, they encountered Lisa, who challenged Ash to a Full Battle. Ultimately, Lisa's and defeated Ash's Chikorita and ; his , , and defeated her , , and , respectively; and Ash's Pikachu and her came to a draw, thus giving Ash the win.

Afterwards, she and her Pokémon had lunch with the group. Upon learning the group was looking for a Pokémon Center, Lisa escorted them to the nearby Greenfield. However, upon arriving, they realized the area had been turned into a crystal wasteland that was still spreading. and soon arrived to investigate the phenomenon, including the disappearance of their mutual friend Spencer Hale.

Following Delia's kidnapping by an , Ash and his friends went against Oak's orders and rushed to the epicenter of the event, the Hale mansion. In support of Ash, Lisa gave Ash her Pokégear to coordinate the rescue mission and then remained at the Pokémon Center with Oak and Schuyler.

After the crisis was resolved, Lisa waved goodbye to the group and left to continue her journey.

==Character==
Lisa is amiable, easygoing, and enjoys a challenge. She also looks out for her friends, like when she gave Ash her Pokégear to avoid having him rush into things without any help.

==Trivia==
Lisa's bandanna slightly resembles the one wore during . Coincidentally, they both were dubbed by the same voice actress in .
Lisa's voice actress later voiced from seasons 4 to 11.
Lisa shares her name with her English voice actress.
Lisa has two Pokémon Ash owned at one point ( and ), as well as the pre-evolved form of a third, . However, none of these three remain in Ash's immediate possession and Ash also hadn’t caught an Aipom at the time.
All of Lisa's Pokémon either received a type change ( ), new Evolution ( , and ), regional variant ( ) or temporary form (Gigantamax ).
